reviews.title: The church has control over your account
reviews.text:
If you are a musician you need to know a couple of things: (1) This software is incredibly clunky to use if you play at multiple churches, and (2) The churches have control over your account. You cannot remove a church from your account unless the church grants you permission. 

I understand the churches are the paying customers, but this app will not exist without the continued support of musicians.  The developer needs to understand they are leaving a big opportunity for a competitor to pop up, because the rank and file musicians have a lot of sway with their MDs.

reviews.title: Id give zero stars if I could
reviews.text:
Ok, I downloaded this app to help with my church and I open it to find I can’t create an account in app I HAVE to do it on the website so I do and no matter what I do, I CANNOT create a working account, none of them work! I’ve tried two different emails and neither worked! Then I went to the website to make an account and it worked so I open the app and it’s saying my account doesn’t exist! Then I try a website that I think ‘parents’ this apps website to supposedly make it work better and my account doesn’t exist on there so I decide to just make ANOTHER new account with one of my emails and I CANT CAUSE THE SIGN UP BUTTON TAKES ME TO A PURCHASING PAGE! I have to start a trial and later PAY MONEY to have an account CAUSE THERE IS NO OTHER WAY TO CREATE AN ACCOUNT ON YOUR WEBSITES! NONE! 

fix your broken website and don’t get me STARTED on the interface and accessibility, it was a NIGHTMARE to work with!

reviews.title: Why is it so slow?
reviews.text:
So the app is really great and useful for planning and scheduling church serve times. My main complaint or I should say two complaints are: 
#1 Why is it so slow? It takes forever for the app to load and then if you switch to a different section, it takes forever again. I don’t understand! I thought maybe it was the Wi-Fi at our church because it can be a little sketchy, but I have gig Wi-Fi at home and it is still ridiculously slow. 
#2 Navigating the app is a little cumbersome. It is not well organized and it is not clear where to find things. I wish that there was a menu bar with drop-down categories at the top that just had every section of the app listed so that you didn’t have to click through all of these slow links to try to find what you’re looking for. Why isn’t there a drop down menu? That’s pretty standard in almost every other app that I use. Fix the speed that the app loads at and also fix the user interface/experience and this would be a rocketship for church planning.

reviews.title: Update printing broke
reviews.text:
After the latest update, the print functionality is not working properly and is significantly less intuitive than before. In the Print section, teams do not load when attempting to select them for printing. Additionally, there appears to be no option to save print settings within a report, requiring the print configuration to be recreated each time.

These issues have negatively impacted workflow and efficiency. Please advise on whether this is a known issue and if a fix is forthcoming.

reviews.title: App is awful. Security codes never send.
reviews.text:
I seriously don't understand how this is the same company behind the website. I don't know what's going on on your end but over the last 2 to 3 years using your products has gotten significantly more frustrating. Quality has diminished. 

Not to mention that I can't even use any of these services anymore because you're two factor authentication is so poorly pieced together that half the time it never sends you a code and the other half the time it takes so long to receive one that the security measures time out and make you do it again starting the entire process over keeping you locked out of your account. This is not the first time that two factor authentication has been an absolute headache. This has been a problem for years now. 

If the service is getting too expensive to maintain properly then you need to go back to the drawing board reduce the number of available features and make this work efficiently. You are nowhere near large enough of a company for this level of scope creep.
